samples: This module defines an immutable generic stack type with basic operations to create an empty stack, push an item, pop the top item, and peek at the top item, plus a size/is-empty ability implementation. It also provides a bracket checker that scans text and returns true only when round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order, ignoring other characters. The tests confirm that popping an empty stack yields nothing and that push/peek/size behave like a last-in, first-out stack.

This module provides an immutable generic stack type with basic operations to create an empty stack, push an item, pop the top item, and peek at the top item, plus a size/is_empty ability implementation. It also includes a bracket-balance checker that scans text and verifies that round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order, ignoring other characters. The tests confirm that popping an empty stack yields nothing and that the most recently pushed item is on top.

This module defines an immutable generic stack type with basic operations to create an empty stack, push an item, pop the top item, peek at the top item, and query its size or emptiness. It also provides a bracket-balance checker that scans text and returns true only when round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order, ignoring all other characters. The included tests verify that popping an empty stack yields nothing and that push/peek/size behave like a normal last-in, first-out stack.
